sample_unit: patients treated with vedolizumab (32 CD, 41 UC)

links.outcome: Predictive performance of CDSTs on local retrospective data across remission outcomes at weeks 14, 30, 54
links.effect: UC CDST predicted outcomes at week 54 (CREM 33.3% vs 81.8%, p=0.003; CompREM 33.3% vs 86.4%, p<0.001; CSF-CREM 22.2% vs 77.3%, p=0.001). CD CDST showed no significant differences for any outcome.
links.quote: For CD patients treated with vedolizumab, the CDST could not predict effectiveness outcomes.

unlisted_practices: Testing specificity of a drug-response prediction tool by applying it to patients treated with a different drug (ustekinumab)

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world external validation of existing clinical decision support tools (CDSTs) in a Dutch hospital cohort before implementation.
